hello, world

2026-09-02 · 1 min read · #meta#jekyll

New site, who dis. This blog is built with Jekyll and styled with terminal.css, hosted for free on GitHub Pages.

Writing a post

Create a file in _posts/ named YYYY-MM-DD-some-title.md:

---
title: "My new post"
tags: [notes]
---

Write in **Markdown**. That's it.

Push to main and GitHub Pages rebuilds the site in about a minute.

buttons
